instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot. In a spacious studio with a red carpet and white walls, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, executing a high side kick with his right leg. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing him, observing the kick. The room is brightly lit by overhead lights, showing a wooden floor section in the background.
